object_description: single building of four offset structural sections with distinct roofs
design_condition: The building significantly interrupts the natural landscape while its offset placement creates diverse, protected outdoor spaces and exterior clearances.

positive.statement: The structural framework makes the interior spaces functional and flexible.
The offsets between the volumes allow views and clearances to the outside.
The quality of the spaces offered to creative manual activity classes is appreciated.
The architecture offers a strong and poetic character.

negative.statement: The project significantly interrupts the natural landscape.
There is a conflict between the main entrance and the ramp of the gymnastics hall.
The nursery school layout deserves to be less dispersed, and the two classes should be at the same level.
Some storage rooms are missing, and the size of certain rooms is not respected.
Separating the school from the different playgrounds is not very functional.
The proliferation of roof-façade connections raises doubts about maintenance and the economics of the project.
The ratio between the envelope and the surfaces is not optimal.
